BEFORE metrics: capture the post-P1 state as metrics-p2-before.json (scalars + edge totals + resolved-ids hash + unresolved-by-reason).

Contract tests BEFORE implementation (__tests__/pipeline/external-receiver-disposition.contract.test.ts): (a) member calls on receivers bound to EXTERNAL package imports (namespace, default, named local binding) classify external with reason='external_module_receiver', including dotted roots (ts.factory.createIdentifier); (b) cast/paren-wrapped receivers ((ts as any).x, (ts).x) normalize to the underlying identifier and classify the same; (c) node-builtin receivers still classify builtin_module_receiver (precedence unchanged); (d) PROJECT-import receivers still take branch 4 (ambiguous/imported_receiver_method_unknown) - never external; (e) unknown non-import receivers stay unresolved; (f) dotted receivers whose ROOT is in BUILTIN_RECEIVERS (process.stderr.write) classify builtin; (g) zero resolved-edge mutation (this phase adds NO resolved edges).

Implement in call-resolver.ts: (i) receiver-core normalization helper stripping cast/paren wrappers to a root identifier; (ii) new branch 3.7 - receiver (or its dotted/normalized root) bound by an ImportResolution with kind='external' => {kind:'external', reason:'external_module_receiver'} (after 3.5/3.6 so builtin/stdlib keep precedence, before branch 4); (iii) extend branch-1 builtin check with a pure-dotted-chain root match against BUILTIN_RECEIVERS (reason='builtin_root_receiver'). Classification-only: no new resolved edges, edge ids status-invariant.

Assert resolved-edge ids hash IDENTICAL (zero fabricated edges); unresolved_count and unresolved_src_count drop by the flipped population; external_count/builtin_count absorb it; record metrics-p2-diff.md with per-branch attribution.

Confirm the seams: classifyMethodCall branches 1 (this.X same-file own-methods only), 2 (super.X hard-unresolved 'super_call_out_of_scope'), 3 (scope-binding own-methods filter qualifierPath===[className], guardrail-3 'no parent-class walking' being retired by this phase), and the ACG fall-through interplay (the 645-edge note: 'new'-binding inherited-method misses currently rescued provisionally by the bare-name field index). Confirm state.heritage (HeritageRelationship[] subtypeName/supertypeName/kind, genre-features P5) threads through resolveCallsAgainstTable, and the module idiom (field-index.ts / scope-binding.ts siblings). Planning-gate honesty: this repo's live heritage estate is 22 extends/implements edges, so self-scan deltas will be SMALL; the phase's value is repo-agnostic recall + type-proven precision upgrades, carried by fixture contract tests.
BEFORE metrics: capture the post-P2 state as metrics-p3-before.json (scalars + edge totals + resolved-ids hash + unresolved-by-reason + ambiguous-by-reason).

Contract tests BEFORE implementation (__tests__/pipeline/heritage-method-lookup.contract.test.ts): (a) `const a = new A(); a.fromBase()` with `class A extends Base` resolves EXACT to Base.fromBase with reason='heritage_method_lookup'; (b) multi-level chain (A extends B extends C, method on C) resolves through the chain; (c) heritage cycle (A extends B, B extends A) terminates without hang and leaves the prior classification; (d) `super.x()` resolves to the parent's method; super with heritage present but method absent yields 'super_method_not_in_heritage'; super with NO heritage facts keeps 'super_call_out_of_scope'; (e) inherited `this.x()` (method on parent, call in child) resolves via the chain; (f) OWN method shadows inherited same-name (nearest-definition-wins, existing branch-1/3 exact resolution unchanged); (g) external/unknown supertype (extends from an unimported or external name) leaves the result exactly as today - no fabricated edges; (h) same-ancestor-name multi-file collisions yield ambiguous with candidates, never silent resolution; (i) annotation/param bindings (`const x: A`, `(x: A) =>`) get the same heritage walk as 'new' bindings.

Implement: new src/pipeline/heritage-index.ts (buildHeritageIndex: Map<subtypeName, supertype entries>; heritageMethodLookup: BFS up extends+implements with visited-set cycle guard + depth cap, per-level symbolTable lookup of `${ancestor}.${callee}` filtered scope==='method' && qualifierPath===[ancestor], nearest-level-wins shadowing, single->resolved / multi->ambiguous). Wire into call-resolver.ts: build the index in resolveCallsAgainstTable from state.heritage, thread into classifyMethodCall (optional param, default empty for direct test callers); branch 1 this.X() miss -> heritage walk before 'this_method_not_in_class'; branch 2 super.X() -> walk from enclosing class's parents (miss with heritage present -> 'super_method_not_in_heritage', no heritage -> unchanged 'super_call_out_of_scope'); branch 3 own-methods miss -> heritage walk BEFORE the ACG fall-through (all three binding kinds). Fires ONLY where today's result is a miss/fall-through - no existing exact resolution is ever displaced.

AFTER metrics: rebuild, re-populate, diff vs metrics-p3-before.json as metrics-p3-diff.md. This phase MAY add resolved edges (first recall phase) - the guards change accordingly: every heritage-resolved target must be a REAL element codeRefId (zero fabricated nodes); no previously-resolved edge is LOST (before-resolved set minus after-resolved set attributed edge-by-edge, expected empty or documented ACG->heritage retarget upgrades); all changed edges carry reason='heritage_method_lookup' or the super/this variants.
